train: train the probability module to generate training questions for sampling without replacement
test: test the probability module to generate test questions for sampling without replacement
test_extra: test the probability module with extrapolation questions using larger sample counts
swr_prob_sequence: swr_prob_sequence the probability module to generate questions about a specific sequence when sampling without replacement
swr_prob_level_set: swr_prob_level_set the probability module to generate questions about a level set when sampling without replacement
